title: Finite-etale lifting over a proper henselian pair

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-restriction-fully-faithful] to obtain full faithfulness for the given fibre i:Y₀ → Y.

Identify Y₀ with the chosen pullback Y ×_A Spec(A/I) using the given cartesian square. Compose each finite etale Y₀-cover with this isomorphism. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-lifting-essential-surjectivity] to choose a lift U and its fibre isomorphism. Pullback.map for the fibre isomorphism is itself an isomorphism and transports the chosen fibre of U back to its base change along i. The projection equations, and cancellation of the fibre isomorphism, give the isomorphism over Y₀. Thus pullback along i is essentially surjective.

The full and faithful instances of the fully faithful functor, together with the established essential surjectivity, give Functor.IsEquivalence. Group-action lifting is the unchanged formal consequence by full faithfulness.

blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** The former proof invoked the torsion degree-zero comparison for
the map $H^0(Z,\mathcal O_Z)\to H^0(Z_0,\mathcal O_{Z_0})$ on structure
sheaves; that citation applies in neither reading, since the structure sheaf
is not torsion and the two sheaves are different objects. The needed statement
is the idempotent lifting interface
[thm-weil-pbc-henselian-idempotent-lifting], which the proof now cites. The
rest of the proof — properness of $Z$ over $S$, the dictionary between
$Y$-morphisms $Y\to Z$ and rank-one idempotents, the Hom-computation, and
uniqueness of the lifted group action — is proved here and depends on no
further input.

split_report.summary: Statement made precise (functor = base change U -> U x_Y Y_0 on FEt with Y-morphisms; (a) fully faithful, (b) essentially surjective, (c) equivalence, (d) unique lifting of group actions, a formal consequence of (a)+(b)); new stmt_dep def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category (Mathlib leaf, MorphismProperty.Over / Over.pullback). The Stacks statement for a henselian pair is Tag 0GS2 (pione.tex), 0A48 being the henselian local case; Stacks proves full faithfulness by a graph argument from essential surjectivity. Full faithfulness is written along the imported proof's route (idempotent lifting thm-weil-pbc-henselian-idempotent-lifting, Stacks 0A0B), which needs no essential surjectivity: Hom = sections of V x_Y U -> U = clopen pieces mapping isomorphically to U (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-section-clopen-immersion), clopens correspond, and the degree-one condition descends (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-flat-rank-iso plus the fact that a clopen of U missing U_0 is empty). Corrected: the imported proof's claim that Y_0 -> Y is surjective (false; a closed immersion). Gap filled: the imported proof derived essential surjectivity from 0A0C/0A3S, which are H^0 comparisons and do not give it; it is now the new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-lifting-essential-surjectivity (Stacks 0GS2 algebraization/approximation/limit route). Not in Mathlib (three searches): no henselian pairs for schemes.
